Answer: B
Reason: The axial CT images (particularly Figure 2) clearly demonstrate a distinct collection of air within the spinal canal (pneumorrhachis), alongside pneumomediastinum and subcutaneous emphysema. In the context of extensive barotrauma or mediastinal air tracking, pneumorrhachis is typically a benign, self-limiting finding that resolves spontaneously without surgical intervention.
